self.title: Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory

detail.title: Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory
detail.question: Can autocatalytic reaction networks demonstrate history-dependent responses that function as memory rather than simple state hysteresis?
detail.reason: Attention enforcement requires aligning new research with the autocatalytic_memory topic; this project transitions the focus from theoretical thresholds to experimental validation of memory mechanisms.
